intro.text: A Thaylen Shardbearer in the highguard that protects the throne in Thaylen City.

items.text: Estnatil probably inherited his Shard from his father. He was standing on the city wall when a thunderclast broke it, and he died buried in the rubble with his Shardblade. After the wall was patched, Jasnah found the Blade and Soulcast the rubble to smoke, and Adolin gave it to Fen's son Kdralk to hold the Low Ward.
